programs.title: My Cat From Hell: My Therapy Cat Needs Therapy
programs.desc: Jackson has a tall order in Delaware helping a veteran with PTSD whose therapy cat, Salem, stresses him out  the Cat Daddy deals with Bartholomew, a cat shredding the furniture and tearing up a marriage.

programs.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Devil's Island
programs.desc: Host Dave Salmoni visits one of the world's untouched rainforest islands  the green jewel of an island carries a dark secret.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Bindi's Lemur Island
programs.desc: The Australia Zoo's alligator snapping turtles need a health check, and it's Robert's job to protect from their fierce bites  Terri and Bindi welcome seven new lemurs from the United States  the Rescue Unit must save possums caught in a chimney.

programs.title: Meet the Orangutans: Dealing With Stubbornness and Illness
programs.desc: One young orangutan, traumatized after losing its mother, settles into the sanctuary, though it needs motivation to practice climbing  another is sent to a protected reserve for an x-ray.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.
programs.desc: From rhino saviors and lion researchers to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. Ivan journeys to four separate countries.
